visualizationDefinition: Displays a table for one explored run of the NFA on the input string at a time, showing the symbol consumed, the state transition, and acceptance at each step of that run. Accepting runs are listed before rejected runs, so the default run shown is the first accepting run, or the first rejected run if none accept.

solver.solverDefinition: This solver enumerates all accepting runs of a nondeterministic finite automaton (returns all successful state sequences).
